p3c28.title: The Existential and Ontological Exposition of the Problem of History
p3c28.contentRationale: Hinge into history (20 paras): death was only one 'end' of Dasein — birth is the other, and the birth-death 'connection' is ontologically obscure (p3-p4). The 'more simple' life-connection of successive experiences is unmasked as the vulgar now-series (p5). Opener stages the cohort's founding event: flecks SETTLE into the first strata — the past gaining sediment layers — under a shaft widened to 75%. The threshold well carries p0's return to 'the one goal' (the question of the meaning of being in general).

p3c30.title: The Essential Constitution of Historicity
p3c30.contentRationale: Cohort PEAK (15 paras): fate [Schicksal] (p5-p8), destiny [Geschick] as occurrence-with of a people (p7: 'If Dasein, anticipating, lets death become powerful in itself...'), repetition [Wiederholung] fetching heritage (p9-p10: 'choose its hero', kampfende Nachfolge), the Moment (p9: 'be in the Moment for its time'), authentic historicity rooted in the future (p11-p12). Opener stages repetition structurally: strata BEND upward toward a bright horizontal Moment-line while retrieval threads rise from layer to line — fetching, not copying. Largest ghost in cohort.

p3c34.title: The Incompleteness of the Foregoing Temporal Analysis of Dasein
p3c34.contentRationale: The 4-paragraph hinge of Division Two: reckoning with time must be clarified (p1: 'The elemental mode of behavior of reckoning with time'), the vulgar concept comes from leveling down primordial time (p2), and the coming program is named — subjective/objective vacillation, Hegel's time-spirit unity (p3). Smallest plate in cohort: strata fall to three thin lines, the upper field empties, one full-width hairline rule marks the turn from history to time. Smallness is the content: a hinge, not a hall. Smallest ghost; no dividers; no breathers — four paragraphs breathe as one held thought.

p3c37.title: Within-Timeness and the Genesis of the Vulgar Concept of Time
p3c37.contentRationale: The vulgar genesis (16 paras): Aristotle's definition — time as 'what is counted' in the making-present of the moving pointer (p1), the succession of sheer nows, flight from death as the ground of leveling (p8), the final verdict that the ecstatic Moment can never be derived from the now (p15). Content demands the cohort's starkest beat: the LAST TRUNKS FALL HERE — the forest leveled into eleven countable now-dots. Nadir-by-design: maximal gap (94%) with minimal warmth, so §83's flood reads as reclamation.

p3c39.title: The Existential and Temporal Analytic of Dasein and the Fundamental
p3c39.contentRationale: FINALE (378 paras: p0-p3 genuine closing, p4+ served lexicon/back-matter — styled as served, NEVER edited). chosen.name: D1 'Sediment and Signal' (CHOSEN)
chosen.evolution: p3c28 settle (4 uneven strata) → p3c29 ruled (4 even strata) → p3c30 Moment-line (strata bend + threads rise) → p3c31 shards ride → p3c32 lens-ring → p3c33 letter-ticks → p3c34 hinge rule → p3c35 now-line + 3 ticks → p3c36 horology ring → p3c37 now-dots (trunks fall) → p3c38 scatter + held line → p3c39 full clearing + 3 horizons.
chosen.why: The cohort's own two movements — history sedimenting into layers, then time reckoned into instruments — become two legible art registers (strata §§72-78, instruments §§79-82) unified by the horizontal-line grammar that peaks at §74 (Moment), hollows at §81 (leveled nows), and resolves at §83 (ecstasis horizons). Every plate argues its chapter; title-swap test: Moment-lines bending strata, Dilthey-Yorck letter-ticks, and a horology ring mean nothing on any other book.

considered.name: D2 'Clockwork Forest'
considered.rejectedWhy: Gears, pendulums, and escapements across all 12 would over-claim the clock motif (§80 alone earns an instrument; §§72-77 are sediment, not mechanism) and collide with the temporality cohort's tick/notch register. Self-critique: horology-everywhere is the generic 'time chapter = clock picture' default — revised to ONE instrument chapter (hf-80) plus the abstracted now-dot grammar (§§81-82).
considered.salvage: Single horology ring kept exactly once, at p3c36, where the prose earns it; tick-mark discipline informs the letter-ticks (hf-77) and date-ticks (hf-79).

considered.name: D3 'Archive Wall'
considered.rejectedWhy: Openers as document facsimiles — ruled finding-aid boxes, stamp marks, ledger lines — fits §77 (letters) and the §83 lexicon tail but fights §§72-76 (existential argument, not documents) and §§79-82 (time, not paper). Self-critique: ruled-box openers are the generic 'history chapter = old paper' default — revised to finding-aid STRUCTURE (enumerated joints, section turns) rather than paper texture.

readingGrammar.dividers: #chapter-text CSS background fleck bands keyed per chapter (explicit rules): p3c34 NONE + p3c39-archive NONE (content-driven absences); strata rows (§§72-76), letter ticks (§77), instrument marks (§§79-82), one sediment-memory band (§83 after p3). Data-URI SVG, ≤25% opacity, gated like grain.
readingGrammar.breathers: Explicit per-ID paragraph-margin rules ONLY at enumerated content joints (fate/destiny turn, coined terms, letter boundaries, verdict paras, lexicon joints) — no modulo, no formula. Full index table in design/historicity-finale-DESIGN.md §6.

giantsRelief.measure: 38rem for p3c39 p0-p3 (genuine closing); 34rem for the archive region (p4+) and all other chapters.
giantsRelief.archiveThreshold: Explicit rule on body[data-chapter='p3c39'] #chapter-text p:nth-of-type(5) (first lexicon para, 0-based p4 'On the Composition of the Lexicon'): 2.2em top margin — the finding-aid joint between closing and back-matter. Prose NEVER edited.
giantsRelief.archiveRegion: Explicit rules for p:nth-of-type(n+5): 0.94em size, mist-lichen tint, 34rem — reference-room voice; validator computes contrast (tint must keep ≥7:1 on humus or it ships at full mist).
giantsRelief.breathers: FIVE content-borne breathers (explicit indices, no formula): p18 (Latin Expressions — glossary begins), p46 (Husserl thanks — front-matter ends), p127 (Aristotle Rhetoric citation — citation register turns), p164 (Hartmann long note), p244 (Schuldigsein gloss). Each 1.6em top margin. Even spacing is coincidence of content, not a formula.
giantsRelief.railMiniMap: Margin-rail strip (supervisor ledger rail ≥1100px; horizontal strip <1100px; hidden <640px): CSS background on the rail region keyed to p3c39 — the twelve cohort § numerals 72-83 as a vertical tick column with micro-labels via the rail gloss element the supervisor wires; 'you are here' marker = 6px shaft dot at the §83 tick (static — the reader IS at the finale; no scroll animation needed). Pure CSS, no JS, no reader-* classes. Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing changes (already static).
giantsRelief.silence: No floor-breaks inside the archive region — breathers only. NO end seal for p3c39 (binding B6).

neighborCheck: p3c28/p3c29: settled-uneven vs ruled-even strata — lived past vs administered past (deliberate rhyme, inverted).
p3c29/p3c30: even strata vs bending strata + Moment-line — leveling vs repetition (quietest-to-peak adjacent step).
p3c30/p3c31: threads rising vs shards riding — fetching heritage vs encountering things (vertical vs resting).
p3c31/p3c32: shards on strata vs lens-ring over strata — encounter vs thematization (thing vs science).
p3c32/p3c33: lens-ring vs binding-bands + letter-ticks — instrument vs archive (circle vs correspondence).
p3c33/p3c34: stacked ticks vs single hairline rule — letters vs hinge (busiest-to-quietest adjacent step, intentional).
p3c34/p3c35: hairline rule vs now-line + 3 ticks — hinge vs datability (line returns, now speaking).
p3c35/p3c36: now-line + ticks vs horology ring — date-marks vs instrument (line vs circle antithesis).
p3c36/p3c37: ring + glow vs now-dots, no trunks — reckoning vs leveling (composed vs stark; trunks fall).
p3c37/p3c38: even dots vs scattered dots + held line — leveling vs refutation (strongest adjacent contrast after §74, intentional).
p3c38/p3c39: nascent glow vs full clearing + horizons — anticipation vs arrival (the book's last turn).
implementationBriefForEngineer: 1. Author art/historicity-finale.svg per svgPlan (12 <symbol> regions hf-72..hf-83 + shared defs; strokes currentColor/CSS vars ONLY; shaft fills via var(--bt-shaft) with gradient falloffs). feTurbulence grain: include at ≤0.06 opacity inside slot art ONLY; gate OFF under prefers-reduced-motion and <640px (media query hides .hf-grain).

2. Author design/historicity-finale.css: ONLY body[data-book='being-and-time'][data-chapter='<own-id>']-scoped rules (+ body[data-part-id='part-3'] cohort-shared selectors listing own IDs). Slot art arrives via reader.js inlining entries.*.manifest {src,symbol} into #chapter-art (v1.1 — no fragment URLs). Ghost numerals: explicit per-ID #chapter-meta::before{content:'NN'} top-crop rules per ghost specs (§83: shaft color, off-center left 38%). Threshold wells: p:first-of-type Fraunces 21px/1.6 on --bt-under (p3c39 glow-tinted). Breathers: explicit per-ID p:nth-of-type rules per readingTreatment indices (0-based para + 1). Giants: §83 relief per giantsRelief. Print: hide slot art per theme print precedent.

3. Supervisor merges entries.*.manifest into design/chapters.json (src/symbol/class/motif per chapter; motif sets body[data-art]). Supervisor wires rail glosses + railInscription texts + mini-map rail element; this package specifies all content.
4. Prototype FIRST: p3c30 (cohort peak), p3c34 (hinge), p3c39 (FINALE — Phase B exemplar) at 1440×1000 / 820×1180 / 390×844; ArtDirector review before expanding to all 12.

5. Firewall re-check before delivery: no drop caps, no centered titles, no justified text, no glyph ornaments, no cartouche badges, no modulo/hash rules, no reader-* classes, shaft never on paragraph text, contrast mist-on-humus ≥7:1 computed, NO end seal for p3c39.
6. Rail inscriptions: render entries.*.railInscription in the margin rail under the gloss (>=1100px only); Fraunces italic 15px/1.5 lichen (p3c39 shaft-lichen, above mini-map); max 3 lines.

7. Nav codas: implement entries.*.ending (p3c28-p3c38 ONLY) as body[data-chapter]-scoped #chapter-nav::before data-URI SVG micro-scenes (static, print-hidden); keep prev/next quiet text links per ART-DIRECTION 4.6. p3c39 gets NO nav rule — silence is the ending.
8. TOC ticks: per-entry tocTick = gapRamp values for the supervisor's arc-in-miniature TOC.

bindingConditions.B1: Shafts are SVG art (authored polygons + grain inlined into #chapter-art), never CSS stripes — no linear-gradient bar in #chapter-meta.
bindingConditions.B2: Ghost numerals authored + verified: Fraunces 300, 18-24vw, 7-10%, top-crop per-entry table (explicit content rules); §83 shaft at 10% off-center — no badge-like centering anywhere.
bindingConditions.B3: Light NEVER behind body text: slot art terminates above first para; flecks only opener zones + explicit breather rules; mist-on-humus ≥7:1 composited (validator computes).
bindingConditions.B4: Threshold must read designed: Fraunces 21px well with confident inset + size step; fallback (if prototype review fails): quiet Source Serif + shaft tick in margin.
bindingConditions.B5: Ember discipline: NO ember anywhere in historicity-finale cohort (ember = §40 + p3c3-p3c9 only).
bindingConditions.B6: Finale silence: p3c39 = 100% clearing, no trunks, shaft-color title, NO closing ornament, NO end seal, NO nav coda. Prose styled as served.
bindingConditions.B7: Long-chapter relief mandatory: p3c39 gets 38rem (p0-p3) + archive-threshold + archive-region voice + five content breathers + rail mini-map (see giantsRelief).
bindingConditions.B8: Fraunces registry: hold light 300-400 + opsz + WONK 1 + flush-left ledger + straw light; never drift to black/poster/masthead voices.
